name: Nautical Charts
description: Sailor-oriented overlay: OpenSeaMap seamarks (buoys, beacons, lights), depth contours, optional NOAA charts in US waters, and harbours/marinas with facility details. Click a harbour to open its place panel.

dataSources.purpose: Render OpenSeaMap seamark tiles as a transparent overlay.
dataSources.dataReceived: PNG raster tiles showing buoys, beacons, lights, fairways, anchorages, and other IHO S-57 features.

dataSources.purpose: Render OpenSeaMap depth-contour and GEBCO bathymetry as raster tiles via WMS proxy.
dataSources.dataReceived: PNG raster tiles showing isobaths and shaded relief of the seafloor.

dataSources.purpose: Render NOAA Maritime Chart Service tiles in US waters via WMS proxy.
dataSources.dataReceived: PNG raster tiles of the official NOAA paper-chart equivalents.

dataSources.purpose: List OpenSeaMap harbours and marinas in the viewport, enrich the clicked harbour with seamark facilities via Overpass.
dataSources.dataSent: Viewport bounding box, optionally harbour ID + coordinates for enrichment.
dataSources.dataReceived: Harbour list (id, name, coordinates, category) and nearby seamark facilities (berths, fuel, moorings, …).
